_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.integrations. The /dashboard/integrations route in the Workspace Admin app (auth-app) where owners manage verified domains and workspace API keys. CMS console links into this page as a contextual consumer; the actual lifecycle (create / verify / revoke) lives here.
_meta.audience: Authenticated workspace users. Workspace owners and super-admins see the full management UI; workspace members see a permission-aware empty state (BUG-AUTH-6) explaining that owners manage these resources.
_meta.tone: Calm, neutral, transparent. Acknowledge limits without sounding like an error. No marketing language. Short sentences. The permission empty state must NOT read as a failure — it is a deliberate explanation, not a 'something went wrong' message.

title._use: H1 at the top of /dashboard/integrations. Mirrors the dashboard navigation entry the user clicked. Keep to one word when possible.

subtitle._use: One supporting sentence under the H1. Names the scope (verified domains + workspace API keys) so users understand what 'integrations' means here. Keep to one sentence.

activeWorkspaceLabel._use: Label shown immediately before the active workspace slug (e.g. 'Active workspace: xynes'). The slug itself is a code-like identifier and is NOT translated. Translators should keep the trailing space / colon convention so the slug reads as a value next to the label.

domains._use: In-content underline tab label for the verified-domains section. Followed by a numeric count badge. Title Case, one word.

apiKeys._use: In-content underline tab label for the workspace API-keys section. Followed by a numeric count badge. Title Case.

webhooks._use: In-content underline tab label for a future Webhooks section. Currently rendered disabled (placeholder showing where upcoming sections will appear). Title Case, one word.

heading._use: Section heading inside the Domains tab panel, above the add-domain form and domain list. Short phrase, sentence case.

description._use: One supporting sentence under the Domains section heading describing what verified domains are for.

heading._use: Section heading inside the API Keys tab panel, above the create-key form and key list. Short phrase, sentence case.

description._use: One or two sentences under the API Keys section heading. Must keep the security note that raw keys are shown once and never stored client-side.

copy._use: Default visible label on copy-to-clipboard buttons (DNS record fields, one-time secrets). One word, imperative verb.

copied._use: Transient confirmation label shown on a copy button for ~1.5s after a successful copy. One word, past tense.

title._use: Lumia DS Alert title shown when the user reaches /dashboard/integrations without an active workspace selected. Warning variant. Short phrase, sentence case.

body._use: Lumia DS Alert body explaining the user needs to pick a workspace from the workspace switcher before integrations are visible. One sentence.

title._use: Heading of the permission-aware empty state shown when a workspace member (NOT owner / super-admin) opens /dashboard/integrations. This is NOT an error — it explains that owners manage these resources. Keep the tone neutral. ≤ 8 words. Do not start with 'Sorry' or 'Error'.

body._use: Single explanatory paragraph for the permission-aware empty state. Names the scope (verified domains + workspace API keys), states owners manage them, and points to the owner for changes. Do NOT use words like 'forbidden', 'denied', 'unauthorised', or 'access denied' — they would be misleading because the page is still reachable. One or two short sentences.

backToDashboardLabel._use: Visible label on the secondary link that returns the member to /dashboard/apps (the default dashboard landing). Short, sentence case.

title._use: Lumia DS Alert title for a GENUINE load failure (gateway 5xx, network error, malformed response). DESTRUCTIVE variant. Distinct from forbiddenEmptyState — this one means 'something is broken', not 'you don't have access'.

defaultMessage._use: Generic load-failure body when no more specific error class applies. One sentence.

sessionExpired._use: Body shown when the API returned 401. Tells the user to sign in again. One sentence.

rateLimited._use: Body shown when the API returned 429. Tells the user to retry shortly. One sentence.

retryLabel._use: Visible label on the retry button inside the load-failure alert. One word ideally.

title._use: Lumia DS Alert title (warning variant) shown when an action succeeded but the follow-up list refresh failed (token expiry mid-flight, transient 5xx). Distinct from loadError because the user's mutation did succeed.

body._use: Single sentence explaining the action succeeded but the visible list may be stale until retried.

retryLabel._use: Visible label on the retry-refresh button inside the reload-failed banner.

message._use: Screen-reader-visible loading text rendered alongside the Spinner while the initial domain / API-key fetch is in flight. Polite live region; do not include exclamation marks.
